description: Integration verification for aidr_commit_gateway.py (built 2026-04-17). Verify the gateway reads verdicts from mcp_server_registry and refuses to commit MCPs with TRUSTED_GENERAL or TRUSTED_RESEARCH only. MCPs with CAUTION_LIMITED, HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED, or INSUFFICIENT verdicts must be blocked. Query write_service for gateway logs and validate the verdict-check enforcement. Report pass/fail per verdict tier. This is an integration test, not a rebuild of the gateway (aidr_commit_gateway.py is built).
